experience.text: A super-precise cut and styling that complements your features. Afro and curly hair specialists, a hijab-friendly private space, an LGBTQ+ friendly salon, and discreet appointments for high-profile clients.

reviews: I was at the Melissa Timperley salon for seven hours yesterday. The team there are great, really friendly and very supportive.
I’m absolutely delighted with my visit to the salon. The atmosphere was so warm, welcoming, and friendly, and I’m especially thrilled with my transformation by Dawid.

I hadn't been to a salon in years after getting used to cutting my own hair during covid... I then went to Melissa Timperley Hair Salon last week for a wash, styling cut and dry, and my experience was genuinely amazing!  Millie was my stylist and did a fantastic job, she used a shampoo specific to my hair needs, and explained all of the products which were used.

I came to Melissa feeling completely fed up with my hair. I was stuck in that awkward growing out stage after many disappointing haircuts and I didn’t even know what I wanted - I just knew it wasn’t the horrid mushroom cut I had.
